verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents Rico, an in-product assistant. Users ask it plain-language questions about their subscription data, such as "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?", and get direct, data-driven answers, which covers the AI-generated insights half of the story. The docs only show answers to questions the user asks. Nothing shows proactive suggestions or recommendations, and the evidence is vendor docs only. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated suggestions/recommendations (not just Q&A answers), proactive or unprompted insights, independent or hands-on corroboration of Rico's answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Instead of digging through charts and tables yourself, you can ask Rico plain-language questions like "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?" and get a direct, data-driven answer.
